fields.calendarPlusColorGradientEnabled: Enable color gradient in month and week mode

tooltips.calendarPlusTooltipEnabled: Show event details when hovering over or keyboard-focusing an event in any view, including Timeline.
tooltips.calendarPlusColorGradientEnabled: Blend the user color into the entity type color in shared Month and Week views. Day and Timeline use solid entity colors.
tooltips.calendarPlusTimelineEventGap: Horizontal spacing between Timeline events, from 0 to 100 pixels. Use 0 to keep back-to-back events on the same row, or 10 for the original spacing. Larger gaps may push nearby events onto separate rows, especially when zoomed out.
tooltips.calendarPlusTooltipDelay: How long to hover over or keyboard-focus an event before showing its tooltip. Applies to all calendar views, including Timeline. Default: 1 second. Use 0 for no delay; fractional seconds such as 0.5 are supported.
